{{Image}}
A '''scattergun''', also known as a '''scatterblaster''', was an energy weapon similar to the [[Scatter gun/Legends|scatter gun]], a projectile-firing [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrower]]. Scatterguns launched a spray of [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolts, often striking multiple targets. Some slugthrower scatter guns were also referred to as scatterguns.<ref name="TORE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
